11-zoomable-treemap.visual_critic_note: Deliberate HCL-based color system creates genuine depth hierarchy across the three levels, and the clean header/breadcrumb/legend chrome is well-proportioned — held back from 8 by leaf labels that overflow their cells at the rendered size, making many file names unreadable.
11-zoomable-treemap.encoding_integrity_note: Treemap correctly encodes area proportional to file size with data-driven layout and zoom domains, but rng() inside cellFill breaks permutation color invariance and the key function (name+depth+parentName) risks collisions with duplicate filenames.
11-zoomable-treemap.stress_test_note: No update storm (click-only), interrupt() guards mid-flight transitions, pointer events unify mouse/touch — but updateVisibility recalculates label pixel widths using the already-mutated x/y scales immediately after domain swap while rects are still 750ms mid-transition, causing label show/hide decisions that misalign with the visual state.
11-zoomable-treemap.cognitive_load_note: Single-view treemap with 8 colorblind-safe categorical hues, lightness-encoded depth hierarchy, and zoom-to-detail interaction that manages leaf density well — the root view is dense but structured, and the breadcrumb + tooltip reduce working memory burden to near zero.
